{{Top}}
[[File:Giant_Swamp_Slug.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slug]]]]
A '''slug''' was a slow-moving creature. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once compared [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to slugs while boasting of [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|his ship's]] speed.<ref name="ep4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

A species of slug was native to [[Nim Drovis]], where they were farmed by members of the [[Gopso'o]] tribe in ranches.<ref name="swe">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Slugs were also farmed by the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] of [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], who raised them to feed herd animals.<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>
